rca of the issue: Repro: login as admin -> open /ghg/scope1 -> click Add Emission. Console logs repeated HTML nesting/hydration errors indicating span wrappers are being inserted around table primitives (th/tr/td/tbody). Evidence includes x-file-name/x-dynamic markers in console stack, suggesting instrumentation/decorator wrappers are violating table DOM constraints. Mitigation: ensure render path keeps strict table structure (thead/tbody/tr/th/td only) and avoid wrapper spans with display:contents around table tags.
